nodes.name: CHANGELOG.md
nodes.summary: Records released and unreleased changes for the Local AI Chat Studio, including the FastAPI/React v2 rollout.

nodes.name: CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md
nodes.summary: Defines expected community behavior, enforcement, and the private security-reporting route for project participation.

nodes.name: CODE_TUTORIAL.md
nodes.summary: Provides a detailed guided tour of the legacy Streamlit and current FastAPI/React implementations, including end-to-end request traces.

nodes.name: CONTRIBUTING.md
nodes.summary: Explains contributor setup, focused-change expectations, validation commands, API type regeneration, and pull-request workflow.

nodes.name: DATASET.md
nodes.summary: Clarifies that the project has no single fixed public dataset and is intended to process user-provided documents and data.

nodes.name: GRAPH_REPORT.md
nodes.summary: Presents a generated repository graph report with connectivity checks, community hubs, core abstractions, and identified knowledge gaps.

nodes.name: Launch Chat Studio.cmd
nodes.summary: Windows launcher that bootstraps portable uv and Node.js when needed, verifies or builds the frontend, starts the local server, and opens the browser after a health check.
nodes.languageNotes: A batch wrapper extracts and executes an embedded PowerShell payload, combining double-click startup with strict PowerShell orchestration.

nodes.name: Test-LocalPort
nodes.summary: Tests whether the local application port is already accepting TCP connections.

nodes.name: Get-FrontendState
nodes.summary: Determines whether frontend dependencies need installation and whether the built client is stale or absent.

nodes.name: Install-Node
nodes.summary: Downloads a compatible Node.js LTS archive, verifies its official SHA-256 checksum, and installs it into the portable runtime directory.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Project overview covering features, installation, local data handling, architecture, verification commands, and links to supporting documentation.

nodes.name: SECURITY.md
nodes.summary: Defines the local-first security model, sensitive-data boundaries, localhost exposure guidance, and private vulnerability reporting process.

nodes.name: TECHNICAL.md
nodes.summary: Concise developer guide to the FastAPI/React runtime, persistence, sessions, provider integrations, configuration, and contract-generation workflow.

nodes.name: USAGE.md
nodes.summary: Task-oriented guide for launching the studio, selecting providers, managing conversations and memory, and handling privacy or troubleshooting.

nodes.name: USER_GUIDE.md
nodes.summary: Complete product workflow guide for chat, context evidence, backpacks, replay, providers, library data controls, and troubleshooting.

nodes.name: ZERO_TO_HERO_STUDY_HANDBOOK.md
nodes.summary: Comprehensive learning handbook covering concepts, setup, FastAPI and React modules, legacy behavior, end-to-end traces, testing, and contributor exercises.

nodes.name: pyproject.toml
nodes.summary: Defines Python package metadata, runtime and development dependencies, the chat-studio CLI entry point, Hatch build settings, and uv configuration.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses PEP 621 project metadata with a Hatchling build backend and uv-managed dependency groups.
